verified_arabic.result: All standard alert keys OK. Also OK: Reminder Set/Removed, notification panel keys, cancel-meeting template. en: 2490 keys / ar: 3005 keys / missing: 0

confirmed_bugs.text: حذف المنصب؟ | Are you sure you want to Delete AlertTest 1785928738736 position? | إلغاء | نعم، حذف
confirmed_bugs.root_cause: handleDelete in hr/positions/page.jsx passes the whole dynamic string as the i18n KEY: t(`Are you sure you want to Delete ${title} position?`) - key not found => raw English fallback.
confirmed_bugs.fix: t('Are you sure you want to Delete {{title}} position?', { title }) + add the key to ar/en translation files. Also add missing keys 'Are you sure you want to proceed?' and 'Are you sure you want to Delete'.

confirmed_bugs.text: Creating a position with an Arabic title fails with 400 (server English error, shown to user as generic Arabic failure).
confirmed_bugs.fix: Use /^[\p{L}\p{N}\s&-]+$/u (unicode flag) so Arabic titles are accepted.

confirmed_bugs.text: Minified React error #418 (hydration mismatch, args=[text]) fired on 4/4 screens when stored language = ar; 0 errors with default language.
confirmed_bugs.root_cause: SSR renders English (server cannot read localStorage) while the client hydrates in Arabic (i18nextLng=ar).
confirmed_bugs.fix: Persist language in a cookie readable by the server, or add server-side i18n detection, or defer hydration of translated trees.

not_fully_captured: Reminder auto-close toast Alert (meetings): live capture was shadowed by the ProcessingOverlay ('جارٍ المعالجة...'); all its text keys verified present in Arabic. Same Alert base component already verified via create success/error flows.
